versions.changelog:
Initial release of Claw Compactor: advanced 6-layer token compression for OpenClaw agents.

- Reduces workspace token usage by 50–97% using layered, configurable compression (rule-engine, dictionary encoding, observation compression, RLE, protocol optimization, plus live LLM-based Engram memory).
- Includes auto-mode for session-start savings reporting and batch workspace compression.
- Multiple command-line utilities: compress, benchmark, report, estimate, deduplicate, audit, and more.
- Engram system adds live, real-time observational memory, supporting concurrent threads and retry logic.
- Full documentation for configuration (YAML/environment), CLI, and Python API usage.
